title: GET /api/suggest 200
description: Card names that complete the typed text. A pre-v1 endpoint, described here unchanged. When the text starts a word of some names, those names, most printed first; otherwise a misspelling falls back to fuzzy completion, in the engine's order. The list is empty when q is empty or nothing completes it, and it never repeats a name. Only q is read; a q over 256 characters is a 400, error.json. The body carries no request_id (the X-Request-Id header does).
